previousRule: The signed Shopify app proxy serves existing customer operations and has no dedicated Fabric Profile sitemap or source-controlled canonical URL manifest.
newRule: The signed Shopify app proxy may serve one GET-only Fabric Profile sitemap from a source-controlled manifest generated through the authenticated curtains-uk-mtm Admin API. The XML contains only verified live canonical URLs and does not query Shopify on each request.
reason: Shopify native metaobject sitemap child files serve inconsistent Metaobject-ID and handle pagination under identical URLs and ETags, making ordinary reads omit up to 2,586 of 10,208 live Fabric Profiles. One deterministic non-paginated sitemap closes the Fabric discovery gap without changing the native sitemap or any customer, catalogue, Merchant, theme, pricing, stock or database path.
ownerApprovedDecision: Owner approval is requested for this exact read-only app-proxy sitemap, generated manifest and focused regression tests. This record does not approve itself: the protected policy still requires an exact current-HEAD GitHub comment from Nylon1 before PR merge. No Shopify app configuration, theme, Fabric Profile, Browse, FI, Merchant or checkout change is approved here.
